result: I would change the world by ensuring that every person has access to clean, safe, and affordable drinking water. This is a fundamental human right that is still not guaranteed for many people around the world. According to the United Nations, around 2.2 billion people lack access to safely managed drinking water, and about 4.2 billion people lack access to safely managed sanitation services. By providing universal access to clean water, we can significantly improve health, education, and economic opportunities for billions of people, ultimately leading to a more equitable and prosperous world.
